listing.name: Quake III Arena (ioquake3)
listing.summary: Prepare Quake III Arena through its upstream player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use the matching original game
steps.instruction: Use your own Quake III Arena baseq3/pak0.pk3 and the matching official patch PK3s (pak1 through pak8). Preserve the original installation; prepare a separate working data copy.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the player
steps.instruction: Use the official ioquake3.org Get It page and player guide to obtain the complete Windows player folder, then prepare baseq3 as documented. The official guide names ioquake3.x86_64.exe. Register that player with its working ioquake3 folder. There are no GitHub releases in the inspected inventory; the official website provides the download. The package bytes and CPU header were not verified by this research because the download transport returned HTTP 403.

steps.title: Preserve the actual player data
steps.instruction: Windows normally uses %APPDATA%/Quake3 for user configuration, demos, videos, screenshots and downloaded PK3s. Explicit fs_homepath settings redirect storage. Preserve the actual profile, game/mod data and working runtime before upstream updates; no server-download trust or cross-version save compatibility is inferred.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream preparation before registration. Register the real player with its matching working directory and separate literal argument lines. Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this runtime, original files, saves and configuration. Registration-only removal preserves these external files; managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are unavailable for them. Preserve the working runtime and every actual data/profile location with the game closed before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own upstream flow.

warnings: Official Windows distribution is documented, but its package bytes were not obtained in this audit. No artifact or native gameplay qualification is added.
